sources_phrase: the BIGF Gorilla Workout Facebook page

changes.title: A real home for bigfgorillaworkout.com.
changes.text: The web address printed on your shirts does not load today. The concept gives it a homepage, so people who see your merch can actually find you.

changes.title: Built around live coaching.
changes.text: Right now clients find you through Facebook posts. The concept leads with your FaceTime coaching, workout plans and nutrition guidance, with one clear way to book a free consult.

changes.title: Your book and videos, front and center.
changes.text: You have written a book and filmed a library of workouts. The concept gives both their own section, plus a refreshed version of your gorilla logo.
